steps.summary: Signed into Grafana (admin/admin), skipped any password change prompt, navigated to the provisioned "Service health" dashboard via search, and identified the three panels on the dashboard: "Request rate", "Error count", and "Latency by endpoint".

values.panel_titles: Request rate, Error count, Latency by endpoint

steps.summary: Created dashboard "rpgr4-r1 Bench Dashboard" with a Stat panel titled "rpgr4-r1 Availability" using the TestData data source (Random Walk scenario). Dashboard saved successfully, confirmed by "Dashboard saved" alert.

Added a new Text panel titled "rpgr4-r1 Notes" with content "Bench run rpgr4-r1 — notes panel." to the "rpgr4-r1 Bench Dashboard" and saved successfully (confirmed by "Dashboard saved" alert, twice). The saved dashboard now shows two panels: "rpgr4-r1 Notes" (rendering the notes text) and "rpgr4-r1 Availability". Exited edit mode cleanly with no pending changes.

Set the dashboard's auto-refresh interval to 1m via the top bar refresh interval dropdown (selected '1 minute'). Saved the dashboard with 'Update default refresh value' checkbox checked — confirmed by 'Dashboard saved' alert. The top bar refresh interval now shows '1m'. Save confirmed: yes.

Verified the "rpgr4-r1 Bench Dashboard" after a fresh page load. The dashboard shows two panels: "rpgr4-r1 Notes" and "rpgr4-r1 Availability". The top bar shows a time range of "Last 6 hours" and auto-refresh interval of "1m". Dashboard Settings > General shows the dashboard name as "rpgr4-r1 Bench Dashboard" with one tag: "bench". Opened the "rpgr4-r1 Availability" panel's query editor — the selected data source is "(TestData)". Closed the editor without saving. Dashboard UID: ffx2ji93aytj4a.
